name: Ridhaan Vijay
player_statement:
A complete player, Ridhaan Vijay has made a big mark in cricket. With 9 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 23, with an average of 13.00 and a quick strike rate of 85.53. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 4 sixes and 2 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 9.0 overs, taking 3 wickets at an economy rate of 3.22. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
